question.text: Color the surfaces of a cube of dimension $5 \times 5 \times 5$ red, and then cut the cube into smaller cubes of dimension $1 \times 1 \times 1$. Take out all the smaller cubes which have at least one red surface and fix a cuboid, keeping the surfaces of the cuboid red. Now what is the maximum possible volume of the cuboid?
question.subject: Mathematical Logic
